landing_faq_subtitle: Answers to common questions about Tahsel application
landing_faq_a1: Yes, you can try Tahsel completely free for 15 full days with all features included. No upfront credit card or payment required.
landing_faq_q2: What is the difference between Standard and VIP plans?
landing_faq_a2: Standard plan covers core essential management: sales, invoices, customer debts, supplier debts, expenses, and financial reports. VIP plan adds advanced capabilities: inventory management, purchase invoices, supplier tracking, employee management, and cash register/vault control.
landing_faq_q3: Can I run Tahsel on both Mobile and Desktop?
landing_faq_a3: Yes! When choosing the (Mobile + Windows) option, you can use the app on Android, iPhone, and Windows PC simultaneously with instant real-time sync.
landing_faq_q4: How do 6-month, Annual, and Lifetime options work?
landing_faq_a4: On the 6-month plan you pay for 5 months and get 1 month free. On the Annual plan you pay for 10 months and get 2 months free. The Lifetime option is a one-time payment for permanent access with no recurring subscription fees.
landing_faq_q5: Does the application require an internet connection?
landing_faq_a5: Tahsel requires an active internet connection to synchronize data seamlessly across all devices and team members in real-time.
landing_faq_a6: You can pay via Vodafone Cash, InstaPay, or bank transfer after your 15-day free trial ends.
